name: Advanced FedEx Shipping – Live Rates & Address Validation for WooCommerce
author: oneteamsoftware

sections.description:
VERSION 2.0 – COMPLETELY REBUILT! Advanced FedEx Shipping has been rebuilt from the ground up on the modern FedEx REST API — with real-time rates at cart and checkout, per-zone configuration, a guided setup checklist, and a redesigned settings experience.

Advanced FedEx Shipping connects your store to your own FedEx account so shoppers see accurate, real-time FedEx rates at cart and checkout.

Upgrade to FedEx Shipping PRO for shipping labels, tracking, returns, address validation and FedEx Freight (LTL).

Features

  • Live FedEx shipping rates at WooCommerce cart & checkout
  • Enable for Shipping Zones or globally
  • Min and max rate cost requirement for shipping rate to be displayed during checkout
  • Control max number of live shipping rates that will be displayed in the cart and checkout pages
  • Request rates for each product or for entire contents of a cart
  • Accommodate packaging and marketing material with flexible package weight adjustments
  • Charge extra handling fee or implement currency conversion with flexible shipping rate adjustments
  • Test your setup before going into production by running in the sandbox
  • Easily find issues by enabling debug mode
  • Speed up your website by caching and re-using previously found rates

PRO Features

  • Print FedEx shipping labels in one click
  • Void / refund labels and create return labels
  • FedEx tracking on every order with automatic customer email updates
  • Address validation before allowing to place an order
  • FedEx Freight (LTL) live rates and Bill of Lading
  • Insurance / declared value and Signature confirmation
  • Display delivery time along with the live shipping rates

PRO Version of the plugin

Translators

If you have created your own language pack, or have an update for an existing one, you can send gettext PO and MO file to us and we will bundle it.

Rate us & Review

If you love our plugins, please give us a full five-star rating, so that we know that our work is valued and appreciated.
This will be the drive and motivation for us to further improve our plugins with more useful features.
We highly appreciate your support and love.

Need support?

Please Contact Us and we will be happy to assist you.

External Services

This plugin connects to FedEx Web Services (the FedEx Developer REST API) to fetch live shipping rates. This connection is required for the plugin’s core function — without it, no FedEx rates can be displayed.

  • What is sent, and when: on each cart/checkout rate request — and when you save the settings to validate your credentials and load available services — the plugin sends the shipment origin and destination address details (country, state, city, postal/ZIP code), the package weight and dimensions, and your configured FedEx API credentials to FedEx.
  • Service provider: FedEx — https://developer.fedex.com/
  • Terms of use: https://www.fedex.com/en-us/terms-of-use.html
  • Privacy policy: https://www.fedex.com/en-us/trust-center/privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress -> Plugins -> Add New
  2. Hit Upload Plugin button
  3. Hit Choose File button and select zip file with the plugin
  4. Hit Install Now button
  5. Hit Activate link
  6. Installation complete
sections.faq:
Do I need a FedEx account?

Yes. FedEx Shipping connects to your own FedEx account, so you get your own negotiated rates. FedEx accounts are free to open, and you create a free developer app to get your API credentials.

Why aren’t any FedEx rates showing at checkout?

The most common causes are a missing or incomplete origin address, incorrect API credentials, or no FedEx services enabled. Enable debug mode to see exactly why, and test in the FedEx sandbox before switching to production.
sections.changelog:
2.0.2

  • Fixed: Signature Type can now be set to No Signature. The option was missing from the dropdown, so every choice applied a signature and there was no way to turn it off.

2.0.1

  • Added: Customs settings are now visible – duties payer, export documents (Commercial Invoice, Pro Forma Invoice, Certificate of Origin, Export Declaration) and export compliance fields. These apply when shipping labels are created, which requires the PRO version.
  • Fixed: internal correction to how shipping documents are requested from FedEx.

2.0.0

  • Completely rebuilt from the ground up on the modern FedEx REST API.
  • Real-time FedEx rates at cart and checkout with per-zone configuration.
  • Guided setup checklist that validates your API credentials and settings.
  • Redesigned accordion settings experience.
  • Updated for WordPress 6.9 and the latest WooCommerce.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
